summary: Image and video generators can produce spatially consistent visual content, but how to use this capability to improve spatial understanding remains underexplored. We study this problem from two perspectives: geometric supervision during training and explicit geometric evidence during inference.
takeaways: We train this decision through reinforcement learning, balancing accuracy gains over retaining the draft against generation cost.
We study this problem from two perspectives: geometric supervision during training and explicit geometric evidence during inference.
To this end, we introduce a unified geometric understanding and generation model (GeoUG) that integrates depth and multi-view generation with spatial understanding.
